title: Watch: Harry and Meghan at first joint engagement since UK return
summary: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex are making several public appearances in Nottingham.

blocks.text: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex have arrived in Nottingham to cheers from crowds in their first joint engagement since returning to the UK.
Harry and Meghan were pictured arriving at the Community Recording Studio charity on Thursday. They are expected to visit two more locations in the East Midlands city during the visit.

The decision to visit Nottingham bears some significance as it is the city where the couple - who are no longer working royals - made their first joint appearance after announcing their engagement in 2017.
